source_evidence.finding: The released GalaxyPPG ACC CSV axes have already been converted to m/s^2 using 9.81/(16383.75/4.0)*value. Keep source CSV values unchanged.
Released CSV contains floating-point SI-scale axes, for example [1.4035029411315918, 2.2992539405822754, 9.551484107971191].

external_evidence.source: Official PPG_FieldStudy_readme.pdf in the UCI PPG-DaLiA release
external_evidence.finding: Raw E4.zip ACC.csv has three 32 Hz axes in units of 1/64 g. This statement applies to the raw CSV, not automatically to the synchronized PKL.

The first ten synchronized PKL samples multiplied by 64 exactly match ten consecutive raw CSV samples. PKL values therefore have unit g; e.g. [-0.765625, -0.078125, 0.671875] corresponds to [-49, -5, 43] raw counts.

conversion_policy: Multiply preserved synchronized PKL ACC values once by standard gravity 9.80665. Do not apply a further divide by 64. This contract does not apply to raw E4.zip/ACC.csv input.
source_scale_note: GalaxyPPG authors used 9.81 in the original raw SDK conversion. The frozen source values remain as released; external g values use standard gravity without changing or refitting the source model.
